author: m. e. griggs
title: Affordable Housing Committee to meet April 9 at James Harmon Community Center
text:
The Village of Hastings-on-Hudson Affordable Housing Committee will hold its regular meeting on April 9 at the James Harmon Community Center, located at 44 Main Street. The meeting is scheduled to begin at 7:30 p.m.
The agenda includes a review of the minutes from the previous meeting held on March 12. Committee member Andrew is expected to provide an update regarding Nick Frascone’s sale, while Patrick will discuss local code and offer recommendations for changes. The committee will also address miscellaneous topics during the session.
Residents or interested parties can contact the committee via email at hastingsaffordablehousing@hohny.gov for more information about participation or agenda items. Details about upcoming meetings and other village activities are available on the official website.
The next regular meeting of the Affordable Housing Committee is planned for May 14.
